facts.fact: O.Economico reports the government has contracted companies to build a digital signature platform, with implementation of the digital identity under way, per the Minister of Communications and Digital Transformation.

MOZ.note: No link between civil register and ID is stated.
Skills appear only as a strategy pillar, no programme.

facts.fact: O.Economico reports the Ministry of Communications and Digital Transformation launched a public consultation to draft the National Digital Transformation Strategy, with five priority pillars identified.

MOZ.note: No e-commerce or electronic transactions law is stated.
The citizen portal is only contracted, not launched or piloted.
The consultation is not stated to run online.
No enrolment count or share is given.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or maintains the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: O.Economico reports implementation of Mozambique's digital identity is under way, per the Minister of Communications and Digital Transformation.

O.Economico reports the ministry launched a public consultation on the National Digital Transformation Strategy at a national conference of government, private sector, academia, international partners and civil society in Maputo.

MOZ.note: No rural electricity access figure is given.
